reader.requirement: At --std 85, executing STOP RUN anywhere in the run unit (the main program, a called or nested program at any depth, inside an in-line or out-of-line PERFORM, a SORT input/output procedure, a USE procedure) must end the whole run unit at once, so that no further statement of any program runs, and return control to the operating system (the process ends; GR2's implicit CLOSE of open files with no USE procedures).

edition-consulted.switches: Constructs.StopRunStatus2002 (ConstructRegistry introduced 2002): refuses the WITH NORMAL/ERROR STATUS phrase at 85 with COBOL0900; plain STOP RUN passes at every edition

reader.edition-search: grep for Edition/DialectLevel in StatementEmitter#Visit(BoundStop), StopRun.cs, ProgramTable.cs RunModule/RunMain and ProgramEmitter#EmitMain: none; grep 'catch (StopRun' over the compiler and runtime: one catch, at the generated Main's RunModule boundary. The only edition consultation is the 2002 introduction gate of the status phrase; BoundStop at 85 has Status null and emits exactly 'throw new StopRun();', the latest edition's code for plain STOP RUN.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only the WITH NORMAL/ERROR STATUS phrase (2002+) is refused at 85; plain STOP RUN behaves identically
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1c30 covers STOP RUN in a called program under an out-of-line PERFORM; not exercised: a nested program two levels deep, an in-line PERFORM inside a SORT INPUT PROCEDURE (the OUTPUT procedure and the statement after SORT must not run), a USE procedure, the implicit CLOSE, and the edition's refusal of WITH STATUS.

probes.printed: M-BEFORE / N-RAN / M-AFTER-NESTED-RETURN / IP-STOP / IN-LOOP 2; exit=0 (OP-RAN, IP-AFTER and M-AFTER-SORT never printed)
probes.expected: STOP RUN inside an in-line PERFORM in a SORT input procedure ends the run unit; the output procedure never runs

probes.printed: B-BEFORE / C-RAN / D-STOP; exit=0 (C-AFTER, B-AFTER never printed)
probes.expected: STOP RUN in a doubly nested called program ends the run unit, not the program

probes.printed: USE 47; exit=0; p5e.dat holds AAAA (the WRITE before the failed READ reached the file through the implicit close); AFTER-READ never printed
probes.expected: STOP RUN in a USE procedure after a failed READ ends the run unit; open files are closed (GR2)

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: STOP RUN WITH status requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85); exit=65
probes.expected: the 1985 format is STOP {RUN | literal-1}; the later WITH STATUS phrase is refused

probes.printed: error COBOL2968: The STOP statement shall be specified only as the last statement ...; exit=65
probes.expected: §1985:VI.6.24.3 SR2 refuses STOP RUN followed by an imperative statement in the sequence

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.24.4 GR1  (6.24.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1
OK  §1985:VI.6.24.4 GR2  (6.24.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2
OK  §1985:VI.6.24.3 SR2  (6.24.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2

reader.notes: STOP RUN emits 'throw new StopRun()', which unwinds every activation to the single catch at the generated Main's RunModule boundary, whose finally writes the exit code; nothing between catches it. Probes from nested programs, SORT procedures and declaratives all ended the run unit at once; COBOL2968 cites the 2023 clause in its text although the 1985 SR2 is the rule applied (a diagnostic-wording matter outside this rule).

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VI.6.24 whole (GR1-GR4). Probes at --std 85 (refute-1985-02/s5): q1.cob dynamic CALL identifier ... ON OVERFLOW of a sibling program that STOP RUNs: printed M-BEFORE / S-RAN, exit=0 (ON OVERFLOW, S-AFTER, M-AFTER-CALL never ran) and the caller's open OUTPUT file q1out.dat holds WXYZ through the implicit close (GR2). q2.cob STOP RUN in a nested program CALLed from a MERGE OUTPUT PROCEDURE: M-BEFORE / OP-GOT BBBB / N-RAN, exit=0 (OP-AFTER-CALL, M-AFTER-MERGE never ran). q3.cob class c: STOP 'OPERATOR-LIT' (the 1985-only literal form, GR4) is accepted, shown, and execution continues (M-AFTER-STOP-LIT); STOP RUN as the ON SIZE ERROR imperative in a program reached by CALL ... ON EXCEPTION / NOT ON EXCEPTION: S-RAN, exit=0, neither exception phrase ran. The only catch that matches StopRun is ProgramTable.cs:531 at the run-unit boundary (grep of catch sites in Runtime and CodeGen); ProgramTable.cs:236 wraps only registrar faults. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.24.4 GR1 (the text is in GR1); OK §1985:VI.6.24.4 GR2 (the text is in GR2).
